label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this _____ from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verse: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
note: Gethsemane's prayer — honest about the cup, surrendered about the outcome.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not _____: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verse: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
note: God leads the returning exiles by rivers of waters on a straight path where they shall not stumble.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being _____ with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verse: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
note: Even Jesus got tired: wearied from the journey, he sat on Jacob's well and soon met a Samaritan woman.

label: Deep Water
prompt: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people _____, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verse: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
note: False prophets put bandages on a mortal wound and said all was well.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall _____ come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verse: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
note: The verse behind the hymn 'Bringing in the Sheaves': tearful sowers 'shall doubtless come again with rejoicing.'
